nonclaims: Human inter-rater reliability (Krippendorff alpha) is UNDEFINED; this script executes deterministic rubric checks and seeded controls only.
Frozen denominators (SL-PLAY-EVAL-001 52/52, SL-BALANCE-PROBE-001 5/5, C-RESULT-* TODO-RESULT) and frozen artifacts were not modified.

Seeded control sensitivity verifies deterministic rubric-detector behavior on known synthetic fault injections across TR01-TR04 (4,656 applicable + 1,584 inapplicable controls), not prospective human assessor agreement or development-comparison-20261023 execution.
TR05 reverse evaluates the 10/10 direct-evidence files supporting gemini-review-20261113 while excluding 10 co-hashed sibling modules under src/nesy_game/*.py captured by package globbing.
Traceability completeness (TR01-TR05) does not imply task success, semantic correctness, or safety (e.g., failed repairs in unchanged_retry score 1 on TR04 while remaining HOLD/FAIL).

reliability.note: Deterministic automated scoring over frozen trace records and seeded controls; no two independent human assessors were run, so human inter-rater reliability remains UNDEFINED per rubric.json.

tr01_tr04_corruption_scope.note: Synthetic fault injection targets row-level TR01-TR04 trace links across 1,248 clean native units x 5 corruption operators = 6,240 candidate controls: 4,656 applicable controls (all 4,656 detected) and 1,584 structurally inapplicable controls retained separately (728 single-attempt units under swap_attempt_id + 856 units without a failed repair attempt under omit_failed_repair). Study-level TR05 requirement/artifact links are evaluated separately.
